dct_description_sm: These 375-plus transcripts document oral history interviews on a range of topics conducted with members of the Vuntut Gwitchin First Nation (VGFN) since 1997. These interview transcripts have been collated and are maintained and updated by the VGFN Heritage Branch in Old Crow, Yukon.
dct_subject_sm: Social sciences, economics and policy -> Adaptation
Health sciences and contaminants -> Food consumption
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Environmental health
Social sciences, economics and policy -> Traditional Ecological Knowledge (TEK)
dct_title_s: Vuntut Gwitchin First Nation Oral History transcripts, Old Crow, Yukon, 1997-2008
